test_has_provider: test the has_provider function that returns True when a runtime provider with a non-empty API key is resolved
test_detect_provider: test the detect_provider function that returns the provider name string when a runtime provider with a valid API key is resolved
test_has_provider_no_key: test has_provider returns False when the runtime provider resolution returns an empty API key
test_detect_provider_error: test detect_provider returns None when runtime provider resolution raises a RuntimeError
test_detect_anthropic: test detect_provider returns 'anthropic' when the resolved runtime provider is anthropic with a valid API key
